<p style="margin-left: 32.6pt;">The development hereby
permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of
this permission.</p><p style="margin-left: 32.6pt;">REASON: To comply with the provisions of Section 92 of the Town
and Country Planning Act 1990.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 39.05pt;">The
development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the
following documents and plans: SD2536(P)01, SD2536(P)02, SD2536(P)03-E,
SD2536(P)04-C, SD2536(P)05-E, Location Plan dated 23 September 2025, Reasonable
exception statement</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-left: 39.05pt;">REASON: For the avoidance of doubt and in
the interests of proper planning.&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify">Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country
Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order
revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no
window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be
installed in the side elevations of the development hereby permitted without
the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:
auto;text-align:justify"><o:p>&nbsp;</o:p></p><p>



</p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-left:32.6pt;mso-add-space:auto;
text-align:justify">REASON: To safeguard the residential amenities of
neighbouring residents, in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013).<o:p></o:p></p>
description: Alterations to front porch roof to raise height, Single and two storey side to rear extension, Alterations to roof to form rear dormer, Roof lights in front side and rear roofslopes, Replacement windows in front side and rear elevations, External alterations (Demolition of attached garage) (Amended Plans)
